info.title: Nagios Core JSON CGI API
info.description: OpenAPI specification for the Nagios Core 4.5.11 JSON CGI endpoints at http://192.168.130.10/nagios/. These endpoints provide read-only access to Nagios monitoring data including host/service status, object configuration, and historical archives.

get.description: Returns runtime status information about hosts, services, comments, downtimes, program status, and performance data.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Specifies the type of query to be executed.

parameters.name: formatoptions
parameters.description: Formatting options separated by a plus (+) sign.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Zero-based index of the first object in the list to be returned. Optional for hostlist, servicelist.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of objects in the list to be returned. Optional for hostlist, servicelist.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: Name for the host requested. Required for query=host and query=service.

parameters.name: servicedescription
parameters.description: Description for the service requested. Required for query=service. Depends on hostname.

parameters.name: hostgroup
parameters.description: Returns information applicable to the hostgroup or the hosts in the hostgroup.

parameters.name: servicegroup
parameters.description: Returns information applicable to the servicegroup or the services in the servicegroup.

parameters.name: parenthost
parameters.description: Limits hosts/services to those whose host parent is specified. 'none' returns directly reachable hosts.

parameters.name: childhost
parameters.description: Limits hosts/services to those having the specified child host. 'none' returns hosts with no children.

parameters.name: hoststatus
parameters.description: Limits returned info to hosts matching these statuses (space-separated).

parameters.name: servicestatus
parameters.description: Limits returned info to services matching these statuses (space-separated).

parameters.name: parentservice
parameters.description: Limits services to those whose parent service matches. 'none' returns services with no parent.

parameters.name: childservice
parameters.description: Limits services to those having the named child service. 'none' returns services with no children.

parameters.name: contactgroup
parameters.description: Returns information applicable to the contactgroup.

parameters.name: contactname
parameters.description: Name for the contact requested.

parameters.name: details
parameters.description: Returns the details for all entities in the list. Optional for hostlist, servicelist, commentlist, downtimelist.

parameters.name: dateformat
parameters.description: strftime format string for time_t values. Percent signs must be encoded as %25, spaces as +.

parameters.name: hosttimefield
parameters.description: Field to use when comparing times on a hostlist query.

parameters.name: servicetimefield
parameters.description: Field to use when comparing times on a servicelist query.

parameters.name: commenttimefield
parameters.description: Field to use when comparing times on a commentlist query.

parameters.name: downtimetimefield
parameters.description: Field to use when comparing times on a downtimelist query.

parameters.name: starttime
parameters.description: Starting time for time range queries. Plus/minus sign means relative to query time.

parameters.name: endtime
parameters.description: Ending time for time range queries. Plus/minus sign means relative to query time.

parameters.name: commentid
parameters.description: Comment ID for the comment requested. Required for query=comment.

parameters.name: downtimeid
parameters.description: Downtime ID for the downtime requested. Required for query=downtime.

parameters.name: commenttypes
parameters.description: Comment type filter (space-separated): host, service.

parameters.name: entrytypes
parameters.description: Entry type filter (space-separated): user, downtime, flapping, acknowledgement.

parameters.name: persistence
parameters.description: Comment persistence filter: yes, no.

parameters.name: expiring
parameters.description: Whether comment expires: yes, no.

parameters.name: downtimeobjecttypes
parameters.description: Downtime object type filter (space-separated): host, service.

parameters.name: downtimetypes
parameters.description: Downtime type filter (space-separated): fixed, flexible.

parameters.name: triggered
parameters.description: Whether downtime is triggered: yes, no.

parameters.name: triggeredby
parameters.description: ID of the downtime which triggers other downtimes.

parameters.name: ineffect
parameters.description: Whether downtime is in effect: yes, no.

parameters.name: checktimeperiod
parameters.description: Name of a check timeperiod to use as selection criteria.

parameters.name: hostnotificationtimeperiod
parameters.description: Name of a host notification timeperiod to use as selection criteria.

parameters.name: servicenotificationtimeperiod
parameters.description: Name of a service notification timeperiod to use as selection criteria.

parameters.name: checkcommand
parameters.description: Name of a check command to use as a selector.

parameters.name: eventhandler
parameters.description: Name of an event handler to use as a selector.

get.description: Returns Nagios object configuration information including hosts, services, contacts, commands, timeperiods, host/service groups, dependencies, and escalations.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Specifies the type of query to be executed.

parameters.name: formatoptions
parameters.description: Formatting options separated by a plus (+) sign.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Zero-based index of the first object in the list to be returned.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of objects in the list to be returned.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: Name for the host requested. Required for query=host and query=service.

parameters.name: servicedescription
parameters.description: Description for the service requested. Required for query=service. Depends on hostname.

parameters.name: hostgroup
parameters.description: Host group name. Required for query=hostgroup.

parameters.name: servicegroup
parameters.description: Service group name. Required for query=servicegroup.

parameters.name: contactname
parameters.description: Contact name. Required for query=contact.

parameters.name: contactgroup
parameters.description: Contact group name. Required for query=contactgroup.

parameters.name: timeperiod
parameters.description: Timeperiod name. Required for query=timeperiod.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: Command name. Required for query=command.

parameters.name: parenthost
parameters.description: Limits hosts/services to those whose host parent is specified.

parameters.name: childhost
parameters.description: Limits hosts/services to those having the specified child host.

parameters.name: parentservice
parameters.description: Limits services to those whose parent service matches.

parameters.name: childservice
parameters.description: Limits services to those having the named child service.

parameters.name: details
parameters.description: If true, return the details for all entities in the list.

parameters.name: dateformat
parameters.description: strftime format string for time_t values.

parameters.name: hostgroupmember
parameters.description: Limits hostgroups to those containing this host.

parameters.name: servicegroupmemberhost
parameters.description: Limits servicegroups to those containing this host (used with servicegroupmemberservice).

parameters.name: servicegroupmemberservice
parameters.description: Limits servicegroups to those containing this service (depends on servicegroupmemberhost).

parameters.name: contactgroupmember
parameters.description: Limits contactgroups to those containing this contact.

parameters.name: checktimeperiod
parameters.description: Name of a check timeperiod to use as selection criteria.

parameters.name: hostnotificationtimeperiod
parameters.description: Name of a host notification timeperiod to use as selection criteria.

parameters.name: servicenotificationtimeperiod
parameters.description: Name of a service notification timeperiod to use as selection criteria.

parameters.name: checkcommand
parameters.description: Name of a check command to use as a selector.

parameters.name: eventhandler
parameters.description: Name of an event handler to use as a selector.

parameters.name: masterhostname
parameters.description: Name for a master host (dependency selector).

parameters.name: masterhostgroupname
parameters.description: Name for a master hostgroup (dependency selector).

parameters.name: masterservicedescription
parameters.description: Description for a master service (depends on masterhostname).

parameters.name: masterservicegroupname
parameters.description: Name for a master servicegroup (dependency selector).

parameters.name: dependenthostname
parameters.description: Name for a dependent host (dependency selector).

parameters.name: dependenthostgroupname
parameters.description: Name for a dependent hostgroup (dependency selector).

parameters.name: dependentservicedescription
parameters.description: Description for a dependent service (depends on dependenthostname).

parameters.name: dependentservicegroupname
parameters.description: Name for a dependent servicegroup (dependency selector).

get.description: Returns historical archive information including alerts, notifications, state changes, and availability reports.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Specifies the type of query to be executed.

parameters.name: formatoptions
parameters.description: Formatting options separated by a plus (+) sign.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Zero-based index of the first object in the list to be returned.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of objects in the list to be returned.

parameters.name: starttime
parameters.description: Starting time. Required for alertcount, alertlist, notificationcount, notificationlist, statechangelist, availability. Plus/minus means relative to query time.

parameters.name: endtime
parameters.description: Ending time. Required for alertcount, alertlist, notificationcount, notificationlist, statechangelist, availability. Plus/minus means relative to query time.

parameters.name: objecttypes
parameters.description: Object types to include (space-separated): host, service.

parameters.name: objecttype
parameters.description: Object type for statechangelist query. Required for query=statechangelist.

parameters.name: availabilityobjecttype
parameters.description: Object type for availability report. Required for query=availability.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: Name for the host. Required for query=statechangelist.

parameters.name: servicedescription
parameters.description: Description for the service (depends on hostname).

parameters.name: hostgroup
parameters.description: Returns information for hosts in the hostgroup.

parameters.name: servicegroup
parameters.description: Returns information for services in the servicegroup.

parameters.name: contactname
parameters.description: Name for the contact requested.

parameters.name: contactgroup
parameters.description: Returns information for contacts in the contactgroup.

parameters.name: parenthost
parameters.description: Limits results to those whose host parent is specified.

parameters.name: childhost
parameters.description: Limits results to those having the specified child host.

parameters.name: statetypes
parameters.description: State types to include (space-separated): hard, soft.

parameters.name: hoststates
parameters.description: Host states to include (space-separated): up, down, unreachable.

parameters.name: servicestates
parameters.description: Service states to include (space-separated): ok, warning, critical, unknown.

parameters.name: hostnotificationtypes
parameters.description: Host notification types (space-separated): nodata, down, unreachable, recovery, hostcustom, hostack, hostflapstart, hostflapstop.

parameters.name: servicenotificationtypes
parameters.description: Service notification types (space-separated): nodata, critical, warning, recovery, custom, serviceack, serviceflapstart, serviceflapstop, unknown.

parameters.name: notificationmethod
parameters.description: Filter by notification method (command name).

parameters.name: dateformat
parameters.description: strftime format string for time_t values.

parameters.name: backtrackedarchives
parameters.description: Number of backtracked archives to read to find initial states.

parameters.name: timeperiod
parameters.description: Timeperiod to use for availability reports.

parameters.name: assumeinitialstate
parameters.description: Assume the initial state for availability reports.

parameters.name: assumestateretention
parameters.description: Assume states are retained for availability reports.

parameters.name: assumestatesduringnagiosdowntime
parameters.description: Assume states are retained during Nagios downtime for availability reports.

parameters.name: assumedinitialhoststate
parameters.description: Host state assumed when initial state cannot be determined.

parameters.name: assumedinitialservicestate
parameters.description: Service state assumed when initial state cannot be determined.

basicAuth.description: HTTP Basic Authentication. Default credentials: nagiosadmin / password

query_time.description: Time of the query in milliseconds since Unix epoch

cgi.description: The CGI that processed the request

query.description: The query type that was executed

program_start.description: Nagios program start time in milliseconds since Unix epoch

last_data_update.description: Last data update time in milliseconds since Unix epoch

data.description: Response data varies by query type. Contains host, hostlist, hostcount, service, servicelist, servicecount, comment, commentlist, commentcount, downtime, downtimelist, downtimecount, programstatus, or performancedata.
Response data varies by query type. Contains object configuration details for hosts, services, contacts, commands, timeperiods, groups, dependencies, or escalations.
Response data varies by query type. Contains alertcount, alertlist, notificationcount, notificationlist, statechangelist, or availability report data.
